Sitting at the intersection of our AI and autonomy teams, vehicle engineering, and automotive partners, your team will help turn advances in our core technology into safe, reliable, production-ready driving capabilities.

- Develop senior engineers and engineering managers, creating clear ownership while empowering technical leaders throughout the organisation.

- Bring insights from customer deployments back into Wayve’s core technology and product teams, helping shape the evolution of our architecture and global deployment strategy.

We’re looking for an engineering leader who is excited by the challenge of bringing AI-powered autonomous driving technology into the real world.

Windows Server Windows Server 2016/2019/2022/2025

- Verify serials, condition, and disposition on returned hardware so failed parts move back to vendors and good inventory returns to stock fast.

- Write the receiving inspection standards, packaging and handling specs, and defect reporting that every site runs the same way.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Radar Lead

Wayve's Hardware Engineering team develops and integrates the sensor and compute systems that enable our AI Driver to understand and operate in the real world. • Build and enhance test frameworks to evaluate the impact of different radar inputs on model performance, including experiments across adverse weather, occlusion and clutter, and optimise data collection strategies.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Protection Applications
description:
Overview
The Senior Electrical Engineer will lead electrical design teams to deliver high-quality designs for new developments, upgrades, and redevelopments across a wide range of sectors, including power, process, healthcare, transportation, industrial, manufacturing, government, and institutional facilities. This role oversees all phases of design and construction, ensuring electrical plans align with project budgets, technical standards, and client objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead and execute complex electrical engineering projects using advanced techniques to develop new or improved systems, equipment, and methodologies.

• Coordinate departmental or divisional design assignments, studies, and reports.

• Perform detailed power system studies and system protection settings coordination for projects up to the 500-kV level.

• Develop design basis documentation for protective settings and create native relay configuration files.

• Conduct design reviews and support quality assurance efforts.

• Collaborate with project managers to define scope and develop conceptual designs.

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers.

• Contribute to business development and proposal efforts.

Qualifications

• Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, plus a minimum of seven (7) years of experience in electrical system studies within the electric utility or industrial power distribution sector.

• A Masters degree in a related field with at least six (6) years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of the above.

• Eligibility for Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.

Preferred Experience and Skills

• Experience developing protective relay settings in transmission or distribution systems.

• Proficiency with system modeling and analysis software such as ASPEN, CAPE, CYME, ETAP, or SKM.

• Strong understanding of protection schemes and philosophies for transmission and distribution substations.

• Ability to generate native relay setting files using SELs AcSELerator and GEs Enervista tools.

• Skilled in interpreting single-line, three-line, schematic, and functional electrical diagrams.

• Capable of performing and reviewing design calculations, including short-circuit analysis, CT sizing and performance, overcurrent coordination, distance element coordination, and relay loadability studies.

• Experience performing grounding, arc flash, and other power system studies is a plus.

• Ability to provide engineering support during construction and commissioning phases for substation projects.

title: GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM)
description:
About the Job:
AI-powered workflows are only as good as the customer data underneath them. LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As our GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM), you will set the rules that make our core customer data (accounts, contacts, subscriptions, and users) accurate, consistent, and trusted across Salesforce, our billing and finance systems, marketing automation, product usage data, and the data warehouse.
This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of the data model and its standards. You will partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, Finance Systems, Legal, and Security to put those standards into production. Your work is the foundation for reliable reporting, accurate territory and segmentation, clean pipeline attribution, and the AI workflows that depend on high-quality data.
Responsibilities:

• Own the MDM roadmap and operating model for the account, contact, and organization hierarchy domains.

• Define golden record rules: matching, merging, survivorship, and parent/child hierarchies across CRM, billing, product, and support systems.

• Set data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship roles, definitions, and quality SLAs, in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Run the processes for onboarding new data sources, handling change requests, and managing lifecycle events such as mergers, acquisitions, and customer reorganizations.

• Design and monitor data quality rules, scorecards, and dashboards covering completeness, accuracy, duplication, and timeliness. Drive remediation and report data health, risks, and progress to leadership with clear metrics and business impact.

• Specify integration patterns and acceptance criteria across Salesforce, the data warehouse, and enrichment providers, and work with Data Engineering and GTM Systems to build them. Recommend build vs. buy for MDM, identity resolution, enrichment, and data quality tooling.

• Provide trusted, well-documented data products for analytics and AI use cases. Act as the data owner with Legal and Security on PII handling, GDPR and CCPA requirements, retention, and access controls.

•
Who You'll Work With: Data Engineering and GTM Systems build pipelines and Salesforce configuration. Legal and Security own privacy and security decisions, and you inform them as the data owner. You own the rules, standards, and acceptance criteria that tell everyone else what "correct" looks like.

Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience in data management, data governance, data engineering, or analytics, including 2+ years leading MDM or data quality programs.

• Hands-on experience designing match, merge, and survivorship rules and golden record or hierarchy models, with results you can describe.

• Experience with Salesforce data models and CRM data quality at scale.

• Experience building and operating a data governance framework: policies, stewardship models, and SLAs.

• Ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

• A track record of delivering cross-functional programs without direct authority.

•
Nice to Have

• Experience at a B2B SaaS company with a product-led or hybrid sales motion, including mapping product users and workspaces to CRM accounts.

• Familiarity with enrichment and firmographic data, entity matching approaches, and ML-assisted or LLM-assisted matching and cleansing.

• Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and security frameworks such as SOC 2.

title: Research Software Engineering Intern (f/m/d)
description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend. The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do. This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter

You'll partner with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Engineers, and QA, bringing a creative and technical perspective to feature decisions. You'll transform concepts, 2D and 3D artwork, and Figma designs into polished, production-ready features in Unity.

• Lead feature implementation by identifying blockers, coordinating across disciplines, and communicating risks early

• Provide creative and technical input, identifying opportunities to improve designs, animation, visual effects, and implementation

• Set and maintain the creative and technical quality bar for the Game Art team

• Mentor fellow Game Artists through feedback, reviews, and day-to-day collaboration
